current: Section 3.  Additional Rent; Operating Expenses.  In addition to Base Rent, Tenant shall pay as additional rent (“Additional Rent”) Tenant’s proportionate share (based on the square footage of the Leased Premises relative to the total leasable square footage of the property, if applicable, or one hundred percent (100%) if the Leased Premises constitute a stand-alone building) of Landlord’s reasonable, actual, and customary costs of: (a) real estate taxes and assessments in accordance with Article VI; (b) commercially reasonable insurance premiums for the insurance Landlord is required to maintain under Article XII; and (c) reasonable costs of operating, maintaining, and repairing common areas, including shared loading and parking areas (collectively, “Operating Expenses”). Operating Expenses shall exclude, in all cases, capital expenditures, reserves, depreciation, debt service, leasing commissions, and costs of a capital nature except as expressly permitted under Article VIII. Landlord shall provide Tenant with an annual estimate of Additional Rent, payable in equal monthly installments, together with an annual reconciliation against actual, invoiced costs within ninety (90) days after the end of each calendar year, and Tenant shall have the right to audit Landlord’s books and records relating to Operating Expenses upon reasonable prior notice, at Tenant’s expense unless such audit reveals an overstatement of Operating Expenses in excess of three percent (3%), in which case Landlord shall bear the reasonable cost of the audit and promptly refund the overstated amount.
final: Section 3.  Additional Rent; Operating Expenses.  In addition to Base Rent, Tenant shall pay as additional rent (“Additional Rent”) Tenant’s proportionate share (based on the square footage of the Leased Premises relative to the total leasable square footage of the property, if applicable, or one hundred percent (100%) if the Leased Premises constitute a stand-alone building) of Landlord’s reasonable, actual, and customary costs of: (a) real estate taxes and assessments in accordance with Article VI; (b) commercially reasonable insurance premiums for the insurance Landlord is required to maintain under Article XII; and (c) reasonable costs of operating, maintaining, and repairing common areas, including shared loading and parking areas (collectively, “Operating Expenses”). Operating Expenses shall exclude reserves, depreciation, debt service, and leasing commissions, but shall include capital items required by law or that reduce Operating Expenses and capital system replacements under Section 4 of Article VIII, in each case amortized over their useful lives. Landlord shall provide Tenant with an annual estimate of Additional Rent, payable in equal monthly installments, together with an annual reconciliation against actual, invoiced costs within ninety (90) days after the end of each calendar year, and Tenant shall have the right once per calendar year to audit Landlord’s books and records relating to Operating Expenses upon reasonable prior notice, at Tenant’s expense unless such audit reveals an overstatement of Operating Expenses in excess of five percent (5%), in which case Landlord shall bear the reasonable cost of the audit and promptly refund the overstated amount.
